simple.meaning: חָדֵל (châdêl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “vacant , i.e. ceasing or destitute.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Psalms, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Psalms 39:5. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָדֵל (H2310).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָדֵל (châdêl) / H2310 is traced through Psalms 39:5, Isaiah 53:3, Ezekiel 3:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.
